commits.subject: fix(cli): bundle hook script correctly for npm distribution
commits.body:
The bundle script was copying non-existent subdirectories instead of
the actual notify-247.sh file, causing "247 hooks install" to fail on
fresh npm installs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
